preserved.statement: No source record was deleted, rewritten or merged to produce this bank. Question text, options, stored answers and explanations are carried over verbatim; only classification fields, the automatic marking scheme and review metadata were added. Source provenance (book names, page references, answer sources, key-issue labels) is deliberately not part of the app-facing bank — it is recorded in the sanitisation section of this report instead. Where two records look alike both are kept and flagged here instead of being merged.
